column1: # dbtable.furniture carries neither a loc column nor an xp column, and the obj and loc
# names use different vocabularies, so none of this can be derived from the cache. It is
# transcribed from an OSRS 184 reference server, whose item and loc ids match this cache.
# locs      what the piece builds; several means a multi-tile piece.
# parts     hotspot loc id -> the loc that piece puts on that part of the hotspot. This
#           is why a rug lays corners on corners: the reference server pairs its hotspot
#           id array with its built-object array by position, and these are those pairs.
#           A hotspot part absent here falls back to the first loc.
# xp        blank falls back to the material total.
